categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has P2P area label and modifies connection eviction and peer management in src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents nodes from losing transaction relay connectivity when outbound full-relay slots are taken by blocksonly peers. As documented in #16418 and #28371, peers declining tx relay starve a node's transaction propagation graph without operator knowledge, which directly impacts relay reliability and partition resistance.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Test changes in test_framework and fuzz harnesses exclusively support the p2p peer eviction changes.
categories.rationale: Non-member; test edits merely exercise the new p2p behavior rather than modifying general test infrastructure.
